title: OR-MALHEUR NWR-STUBBLE FIRE SEEDING PROJ
description: The Contractor shall provide all qualified personnel, supervision, equipment, supplies, transportation, lodging, field support, research, GIS capability, quality control, documentation, and reporting necessary to complete the cultural resource inventory in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW). The work supports Section 106 compliance for emergency stabilization seeding following the Stubble Fire.
